messages:
Noah D: Dropping a new set of Request Drilldown mocks — focus on stackframe affordances, inline copy for frames, and the export/share surface. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique123 :mag_right: Quick skim and call out any blockers before I freeze the spec.
Ivy (Design): Really like the selected-frame rail. Two quick UX nits: chevron is hard to hit in dense rows (maybe increase hit target), and the inline "Copy frame" icon looks cramped at 12px.
Marcus (Eng): Increasing hit target + 16px touch target is fine. Implementation notes: copying very long frames can block the main thread in older browsers 11; we'll copy via async chunking or use clipboard.writeText in a worker if available.
Ivy (Design): Great. Also thinking about a mini-permalink per frame (right-click -> Copy frame link) vs a global permalink. Which is higher value?
Jules - PM: Product leaning toward global permalinks + selected-frame snippets export. Global permalink for quick navigation; selected-frame permalink for sharing context in support tickets. Prioritize global permalink first.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: copy actions need sr-only text (e.g., "Copy stack frame to clipboard"), focusable icons must have visible focus, and any menu must update aria-expanded. Live regions for long-running exports are recommended.
Marcus (Eng): For exports: three buttons in order: "Quick summary (CSV)" -> includes span durations + top N errors, "Full trace (ndjson)" -> streamable, and "Selected frames (JSON snippet)". We'll emit estimated download size before user confirms and gate full trace on org export policy.
Ivy (Design): Microcopy proposals: Quick summary button label: "Download summary (CSV)". Full trace label: "Download full trace (may be large)". Tooltip for permalink: "Copy permalink (expires in 1h for private orgs)".
Noah D: Good. Also add a small inline toast copy for permalinks: "Link copied. Expires in 1 hour". If permalink is ephemeral, toast should link to a manage-sharing dialog.
Marcus (Eng): Backend: for Private orgs generate signed short-lived tokens via /api/v1/shares, ttl=3600s. For Hosted we can provide stable short links but scrub internal IDs. Will add feature flag to disable full export per org.
Ivy (Design): Keyboard nav suggestions: Enter to expand row, F to focus frame actions, S to start summary export, Shift+F for frame permalink. Keep single-key shortcuts scoped to when a row is focused. Add a help overlay listing shortcuts.
a11y-bot: Shortcut conflict check: ensure global compose/search shortcuts are prevented only when trace row has focus; never override browser cmd+k or viewport-level shortcuts. Provide visible hint in focus ring: "Press S to download summary".
Jules - PM: Acceptance criteria for the ticket: 1) inline frame copy + copy toast + sr-only text 2) export menu with Quick/Full/Selected + size estimate + cancelable progress 3) global permalink with ephemeral tokens for Private orgs + toast behavior 4) keyboard shortcut matrix documented + conflict checks 5) a11y checklist passed in PR.
Noah D: I'll update the Figma with larger hit targets, new microcopy, and the help overlay. Pushing a spec doc with keyboard conflict matrix.
deploy-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/rd-drilldown-mock-v4.png
Marcus (Eng): I'll schedule a 30-min dev handoff Fri AM and add the feature-flag work to the infra backlog. Also will add API warning header: "Large exports may take several minutes and incur usage charges."
Ivy (Design): I'll include hover/focus states, high-contrast variants, and a no-JS fallback (link to share modal). Thanks all.
Jules - PM: Thanks team 10. Please tag the product ticket when mocks are pushed and include the accessibility checklist in the PR description.
